exercises.why: **встал** — встать (perfective): to stand up, to get up, to rise; to rise (of the sun); to arise, to come up (of a question); to come to a stop. Wiktionary: вс- + стать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **Встань** — встать (perfective): to stand up, to get up, to rise; to rise (of the sun); to arise, to come up (of a question); to come to a stop. Wiktionary: вс- + стать.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **вспоминаю** — вспомина́ть (imperfective): to recall, to remember, to recollect, to reminisce. Wiktionary: вс- + помина́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to glance at, to look at
to stand up, to get up, to rise
to remember, to recall, to recollect
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: взять — to take; взгляну́ть — to glance at, to look at; встать — to stand up, to get up, to rise; вспо́мнить — to remember, to recall, to recollect.
**вспоминаю** — вспомина́ть (imperfective): to recall, to remember, to recollect, to reminisce. Wiktionary: вс- + помина́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **взошла** — взойти́ (perfective): to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body); to come up, to sprout (of a plant); (archaic) to come in, to enter. Wiktionary: взо- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to recall, to remember, to recollect, to reminisce
to start, to startle, to flinch, to wince
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вздохну́ть — to sigh, to take breath; вспомина́ть — to recall, to remember, to recollect, to reminisce; вскрича́ть — to shout out loudly; вздро́гнуть — to start, to startle, to flinch, to wince.
**возразит** — возрази́ть (perfective): to object, to mind, to protest. Wiktionary: воз- + рази́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **возразила** — возрази́ть (perfective): to object, to mind, to protest. Wiktionary: воз- + рази́ть.

exercises.why: **возбужден** — возбуди́ть (perfective): to excite; to arouse, to rouse, to provoke; to stimulate; to incite, to stir up, to instigate. Wiktionary: воз- + буди́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to flash (to briefly illuminate a scene)
to agitate, to trouble, to disturb, to worry, to alarm, to upset
to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вспы́хнуть — to flash (to briefly illuminate a scene); взволнова́ть — to agitate, to trouble, to disturb, to worry, to alarm, to upset; взойти́ — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; вскри́кнуть — to shout out loudly.
